card.name: Close monitoring and discard instructions
card.fires_on: Words of watching or checking such as closely, monitored, observation or monitor, right after close or monitor in a warning. Also the word ard in Disc-ard when a solution is cloudy or discolored.

modes.label: Close monitoring
modes.description: Closely, monitored, observation or monitor in an instruction to watch the patient.
modes.example: Monitor thrombocytopenia of any degree<< closely>>. If the count falls below 1

modes.label: Discard if abnormal
modes.description: The end of Discard in instructions about solution that looks discolored or has particles.
modes.example: The solution is clear to slightly opalescent, colorless to slightly yellow. Disc<<ard>> the vial if visible particles are observed

card.writes: It promotes caution and warning words such as cautious, caution, warned and suspected.
card.plain: It marks spots in a label where the text tells the reader to watch carefully or throw something away.
